name: semantic_anchor_collapse
label: Anchors of Forgotten Truth
poeticVision: Feel the ground crumble not from age, but from the void of your own forgetting. Every lost memory tears a structural wound in the world, twisting familiar paths into impassable chasms, or revealing hidden dangers where safety once stood. The very architecture shifts, reflecting the internal agony of self-loss, turning the struggle for identity into a desperate, physical recalculation of space and survival.
usage: Attach this script to a Node3D in your Godot 4.6.2 scene. As a child of this Node3D, add a MeshInstance3D with an ArrayMesh assigned to its 'Mesh' property. Optionally, add a CollisionShape3D as another child to have its collision updated, and ensure a NavigationRegion3D exists as an ancestor for navigation mesh updates. Set the 'memory_ID' property in the inspector to a unique string. When the global 'MemoryManager' singleton (which should be set up as an Autoload) emits the 'memory_lost' signal with a matching 'memory_ID', this Node3D's mesh will procedurally deform, its collision shape will update, and the relevant navigation mesh will be re-baked, reflecting the loss of that memory fragment in the physical environment.

parameters.name: memory_ID
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the memory fragment associated with this piece of geometry. When this ID is lost, the geometry deforms.

parameters.name: memory_type
parameters.description: A semantic type for the memory (e.g., 'path', 'structure', 'barrier'). Can be used to influence specific deformation patterns (currently uses a generic collapse).

parameters.name: collapse_strength
parameters.description: Controls the intensity and extent of the procedural collapse deformation.

dependencies: CollisionShape3D (child node, optional, for collision updates)
NavigationRegion3D (ancestor node, optional, for navigation mesh updates)
MemoryManager (Autoload singleton, required for memory loss events)
verdict: The world itself weeps with Lyra's fading self, transforming familiar paths into treacherous echoes of her unraveling mind.
impact: This invention profoundly changes the player experience by making the environment a direct, dynamic reflection of Lyra's internal state. Losing a memory isn't just a narrative beat; it's a physical catastrophe that reshapes the battlefield, forcing immediate adaptation, creating new dangers, and constantly reinforcing the urgency of her quest. It turns the abstract concept of forgetting into a tangible, deadly threat, making every step a desperate recalculation of space and survival. The world becomes an active participant in Lyra's struggle, mirroring her internal agony with external, physical collapse.
